name: Avg IO Writes (per Second) per Process and Host

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows "Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process" !"_Total" "IOWriteOperationsPersec" 
| parse regex "winbox = (?<dest_host>\S+)" nodrop 
| if (isNull(dest_host) or dest_host="",_sourceHost,dest_host) as host
| kv regex "= (?:\"|)(.*?)(?:\"|);" keys "IOWriteOperationsPersec","Name" as ioWrites,procName | where procName != "_Total"
| avg(ioWrites) as AvgIOWrites by host, procName
| transpose row host column procName
